# At a party

Lina is new in Freiburg and goes to a colleague's birthday party. At a party where she knows nobody, she meets Roman, who knows nobody either.

:::{how-to-links}
:::

## Hear it in practice

:::{audio-examples}
:track: a1/situations/at-a-party
:title: Auf einer Party
:title-en: At a Party
:mode: dialogue
:presenters: lina, roman

roman: Hallo! Ich bin Roman.
: Hi! I'm Roman.
lina: Hallo, Roman. Ich heiße Lina.
: Hi, Roman. My name is Lina.

roman: Woher kommst du, Lina?
: Where are you from, Lina?
lina: Aus Berlin. Und du?
: From Berlin. And you?
roman: Ich komme aus Kiew. Ich wohne jetzt hier in Freiburg.
: I'm from Kyiv. I live here in Freiburg now.
lina: Ich auch, seit einer Woche.
: Me too, for a week.
:::

## What to listen for

- *Und du?* turns the question back, so the conversation keeps going.
- Roman gives his name with *Ich bin*, Lina with *Ich heiße*: both are normal.
